title: Fact
description: An atomic, source-cited claim extracted from the notice by the Extraction Agent (L4). Mirrors backend/app/schemas.py::Fact. PRD section 6.1.

id.description: Fact identifier, e.g. "f1". Referenced by Scene.referenced_fact_ids and FactCheck.evidence_fact_id.

claim.description: One atomic claim. Never a compound sentence.

source_span.description: Verbatim text this claim was extracted from. Mandatory — it is the evidence a reviewer clicks back to. A fact without a span is dropped by the extraction agent's hallucination guard.

FactType.title: FactType
FactType.description: Mirrors backend/app/schemas.py::FactType. The four values in STRICT_FACT_TYPES (date, number, name, location) get exact-match verification rather than semantic similarity.
